subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Heterogeneous runtime-object cluster recovered from the generic_runtime_objects scope: one-time global state, cursor visibility, list walking, keyframe animation and pit-animation UI wiring, memory release helpers, clamped tuning parameter sets, pit part/menu lookups, path formatting, setup defaults, and session-phase-gated data teardown.

summary: This packet groups nineteen generic runtime-object functions into seventeen conservative class proposals. Strong structural clusters: the keyframe animation object (update 0x004A2840) used by the pit-animation controller (0x004A3390/0x004A34A0/0x004A35F0) which iterates a 120-byte element array and flips widget visibility bits; three clamped parameter-tuning clusters keyed by mode selectors (DrivingModeTuning 0x004ADF10, CarPartVisibilityTargets 0x004AE490, AIDifficultyParameterSet 0x004AE9F0) that share ClampByRange/FloatClamp/ArithmeticComparison helpers and callers into TrackEnvironmentSelect; and small single-purpose helpers (one-time init, cursor hide, list walk, fixed-capacity constructor, pointer releasers, pit part/menu lookups, path formatter, setup-default copier, session-phase gate). All owners are UNKNOWN in the IR; every class trust here is DERIVED or GUESS and no CONFIRMED fact is asserted.

function_roles.role: One-time global state initializer for the session-menu path: reads byte_7CE269, and on first run marks it set and stores a constant in dword_7CE26C, returning the prior flag value.
Forced-hide OS mouse cursor: sets byte_7CE260 then re-issues ShowCursor(0) until the OS display counter reports negative, returning the final count.
Singly-linked-list walker: iterates from the head at this+0x0 through the node chain calling FileSettingsScanner per node and advancing the iterator at this+0x8; returns the final node pointer.
Constructor/initializer: zeroes six dwords at +0x0..+0x14, stores literal 24 at +0x18, returns this.
Piecewise-linear keyframe interpolation with change detection and listener fan-out to every callback target.
Pit crew animation state processor: one-shot reset of child keyframe animations, widget visibility bit flips, animation-state resource cleanup, and conditional recursive UI widget update.
Per-element conditional bit-flag dispatcher over the 120-byte element array; clear-all mode clears every element flag.
Stores a value at this+0x4 and ORs bit 1 into the flags word at this+0x0; returns the stored value.
Computes desired float targets from a phase-descriptor parameter struct and propagates them into 120-byte sub-elements via RangeProportionInitializer.
Pit/garage menu string lookup: maps type id 0-4 to StopGo/Fuel/Tyres/Wing/Damage string literals with an Error fallback.
Finds the Nth valid pit part through CompoundIndexLookup, applying an optional compound filter and a busy-part/session bypass; returns the part pointer or 0.
Conditionally frees three pointer fields (+0x14, +0x0C, +0x04) via FreeWrapper, each null-guarded; returns the last free result.
Conditionally frees two pointer fields (+0x0C, +0x04) via FreeWrapper; returns the second free result or the first when the second is null.
Driving-mode parameter seeding and clamping: dispatches on the mode selector at +0x1CC0 (cases 0-5) and clamps per-mode defaults into parameter slots.
Updates clamped car-part visibility slider targets by mode selector at +0x1AC8 (hide/show/secondary groups) and runs the helper sequence.
AI/track difficulty parameter seeding: dispatches on the difficulty selector at +0x1B10 (cases 1-4) and clamps per-difficulty targets into parameter slots; nested switch on dword_5EC4AC.
Formats a '.bch' output path from a directory field + default, with buffer size checks, extension stripping, and a -1/empty-buffer fail path.
Copies fifteen default setup parameters from the source table and clamps each into its working slot; returns constant 1. Called once from F_5StepInit.
Session-phase-gated season-data free: frees season data at half distance when session type is 5/7, phase reaches 4, and the half-distance flag is set.

classes.name: KeyframeAnimation
classes.responsibility: Piecewise-linear keyframe interpolator: holds a segment table (5 floats per 7-float stride), tracks the last emitted input value for change detection, and fans interpolated/clamped outputs to every entry of a listener callback array.

classes.name: PitAnimationController
classes.responsibility: Pit-crew animation manager: iterates a 120-byte-stride child entry array (count at +0xC, base at +0x10), resets each entry's keyframe animation, flips widget visibility bits through the BitClear/Bit12FlagSet helpers, conditionally recurses the UI widget tree, and propagates computed animation targets into sub-elements. Frame-path calls come from PitStopOperationTimer.

classes.name: PitStopParameterStore
classes.responsibility: Tiny store used by the pit-stop frame path: records a caller-supplied value at +0x4 and ORs bit 1 (value 2) into the flags word at +0x0 as a dirty/change marker, returning the stored value.

classes.name: NodeListWalker
classes.responsibility: Singly-linked-list walker over a head pointer at +0x0 with an iterator at +0x8; processes each node through the file-settings scanner callback and advances through the node next pointer until the chain ends. Invoked during player-file initialization.

classes.name: FixedCapacityBuffer
classes.responsibility: Constructor-style initializer: zeroes six consecutive dwords at +0x0..+0x14 and stores the literal 24 at +0x18 (interpreted by role as a capacity/count, meaning unproven). Returns this.

classes.name: PitPartAccessor
classes.responsibility: Pit-part lookup helper: resolves part indices to part objects through CompoundIndexLookup, applies an optional compound-type filter, and returns the Nth accepted part, skipping busy parts unless the session-type globals allow them.

classes.name: PitMenuStringTable
classes.responsibility: Static pit/garage menu string table: maps an integer type id 0-4 to a string literal (StopGo, Fuel, Tyres, Wing, Damage) via a jump table, with an Error fallback for any other id.

classes.name: CursorVisibilityManager
classes.responsibility: Forced OS mouse-cursor hide: sets the global cursor-hidden flag byte_7CE260 and repeats ShowCursor(0) until the OS display counter goes negative, returning the final ShowCursor result.

classes.name: SessionMenuGlobalState
classes.responsibility: One-time global state initializer for the session-menu path: on first invocation sets byte_7CE269 and stores a constant into dword_7CE26C, returning the prior flag value to the caller.

classes.name: DrivingModeTuning
classes.responsibility: Driving-mode parameter cluster: dispatches on a mode selector at +0x1CC0 (cases 0-5 plus default) and seeds a set of int/float parameters, each stored as a value+min+max triple and clamped via ClampByRange/FloatClamp. Modes 3-5 write slots indirectly through the ArithmeticComparison_20d0 / ClampedFloatSetter_1de0 helpers.

classes.name: CarPartVisibilityTargets
classes.responsibility: Car-part visibility slider targets: mode 1 (hide) and mode 2 (show) write clamped int/float targets on primary part groups; any non-zero mode additionally drives six secondary part-group targets toward 1 and runs a ShortComputation/ArithmeticComparison helper sequence. Called by sub_472930 and TrackEnvironmentSelect.

classes.name: AIDifficultyParameterSet
classes.responsibility: AI/track difficulty parameter cluster: dispatches on a difficulty selector at +0x1B10 (cases 1-4 plus default) and seeds clamped parameter slots (value+min+max triples), conditionally writing a bounded slot when the flag byte at +0x1818 is set; modes 3/4 and the post-switch common sequence route through ArithmeticComparison_20d0 / ClampedFloatSetter_1de0, and a nested switch on global dword_5EC4AC dispatches a final helper call.

classes.name: PathFormatterObject
classes.responsibility: Output-path formatter: builds a '.bch' file path from a directory field at +0x1F9C (or a default string), truncating to a buffer limit, stripping an existing extension, and appending the suffix; returns 0 on success and -1 on failure, emptying the buffer on the fail path.

classes.name: VehicleSetupDefaults
classes.responsibility: Vehicle setup default applier: copies fifteen default setup parameter values from a source table region (+0x496C..+0x49A4) into working slots and clamps each against its stored min/max bounds (via ClampByRange, FloatClamp, or ByteClamp, with the final three clamped inline). Returns constant 1. Invoked once from F_5StepInit.

classes.name: SeasonDataGate
classes.responsibility: Session-phase-gated season-data free: when the global session type is 5 or 7 and the phase field at +0x1F78 transitions through 4 with the half-distance flag set, calls ConditionalSeasonDataFree(1); otherwise returns an accumulated phase/flag value.

classes.name: TriPointerReleaser
classes.responsibility: Conditionally frees three pointer fields (+0x14, +0x0C, +0x04) through FreeWrapper, each independently null-guarded, returning the last free result. Part of a static-init bulk teardown path.

classes.name: DualPointerReleaser
classes.responsibility: Conditionally frees two pointer fields (+0x0C, +0x04) through FreeWrapper, each null-guarded, returning the last free result. Structural twin of DualConditionalFree (0x0049A5A0) per cluster prelabel; called by StaticInitBulk.

state_machines.name: DrivingModeDispatch
transitions: mode selector at this+0x1CC0 selects exactly one case; each case seeds a distinct clamped parameter set; a non-zero selector re-read afterwards runs two ArithmeticComparison_20d0 calls.

state_machines.name: PartVisibilityModeDispatch
transitions: mode 1 writes hide targets; mode 2 writes show targets; any non-zero selector then drives six secondary group targets and the helper sequence; zero takes the shared post-switch exit.

state_machines.name: DifficultyModeDispatch
transitions: difficulty selector at this+0x1B10 selects cases 1-4 or default; a non-zero selector runs the common helper sequence; the nested switch on dword_5EC4AC dispatches one final ArithmeticComparison_20d0 call.

state_machines.name: SessionPhaseHalfDistanceGate
transitions: guard chain: session type 5/7, phase != 3, phase == 4, half-distance flag set => ConditionalSeasonDataFree(1); otherwise an accumulated phase/flag value is returned.

interfaces.name: KeyframeUpdateCallback
interfaces.purpose: Per-listener callback invoked by KeyframeAnimation with the newly interpolated (or clamped) value whenever the input changed; targets live in the listener array at this+0x6C.

interfaces.name: PitAnimationCallbackTarget
interfaces.purpose: Objects receiving pit-animation state flips: widget targets whose Bit12 visibility bit is cleared or set, the animation state resource reset target, and the recursive UI widget tree update.

compatibility_contracts.name: ShowCursorForcedHideLoop
compatibility_contracts.description: ForceHideMouseCursor re-issues ShowCursor(0) until the OS cursor display counter returns negative, preserving the standard forced-hide idiom; a replacement must reproduce the same OS cursor-counter driving contract and keep the byte_7CE260 hidden flag consistent.

compatibility_contracts.name: OneTimeSessionMenuStateFlag
compatibility_contracts.description: byte_7CE269 transitions 0 to 1 on the first session-menu initialization; dword_7CE26C receives the constant 1084227584 on that first run; the initializer returns the prior flag value to SessionMenuModeSwitch.

compatibility_contracts.name: KeyframeSegmentLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Each keyframe segment occupies 7 consecutive floats (input-min, input-max, inverse-range, output-min, output-max); the segment array base is this+0x74 with count at this+0x70, and the listener array base is this+0x6C with count at this+0x68.

compatibility_contracts.name: PitAnimationElementArray
compatibility_contracts.description: The pit animation controller iterates an element array at this+0x10 with count at this+0xC and a fixed 120-byte stride; each element carries an active-state byte, a widget pointer (near element+100), and per-entry flags. The exact per-element offsets are grounded only in raw source.

compatibility_contracts.name: ClampedParameterSlotTriples
compatibility_contracts.description: Tuning clusters (DrivingModeTuning, CarPartVisibilityTargets, AIDifficultyParameterSet) store each parameter as a value/min/max triple (min at +0x8, max at +0xC of the value slot) and clamp every write through ClampByRange (int) or FloatClamp (float) helpers; modes 3-5 additionally route through ArithmeticComparison_20d0 / ClampedFloatSetter_1de0.

compatibility_contracts.name: SessionPhaseSeasonDataFree
compatibility_contracts.description: Season data is freed at half distance only when the global session type is 5 or 7, the phase field at this+0x1F78 reaches 4, and the half-distance flag byte_8ACFA0 is set; the free runs as ConditionalSeasonDataFree(1) and its result is returned.

compatibility_contracts.name: BchPathFormat
compatibility_contracts.description: Output '.bch' path = directory field this+0x1F9C (falling back to default string byte_5EA438) plus the input base with any existing extension stripped; failure (NULL/zero-size/too-small buffer) empties the buffer and returns -1, success returns 0.

unresolved: The 120-byte pit element layout (offsets entry+2, +3, +72, +100, +112, +116 and the 28-byte sub-element stride) exists only in the raw source; no allowed field evidence refs cover those bases, so they are deliberately not promoted to class fields and stay GUESS-by-role.

LinkedListWalker node next pointer is read at node+0x4 in the raw body while the field table labels node+0x0 as the next-node pointer; only the +0x4 access appears in the raw body (packet-noted inconsistency).

All function owners are UNKNOWN in the source IR; the proposed classes are DERIVED or GUESS groupings, not claims about original source organization. In particular DrivingModeTuning, CarPartVisibilityTargets and AIDifficultyParameterSet likely belong to a common large track-environment object (shared callers TrackEnvironmentSelect / sub_472630 / sub_472930), but common ownership is not proven by this packet.

Semantics of the literal constants are unknown: 1084227584 stored at dword_7CE26C, 1203982208 and 99999.0f sentinels in AnimationTargetPropagator, the 0.25/0.5 float patterns, and the fixed argument sequences passed to ArithmeticComparison_20d0 / ClampedFloatSetter_1de0.

DrivingModeTuning modes 3-5 and AIDifficultyParameterSet modes 3/4 write slots indirectly through ArithmeticComparison_20d0/ClampedFloatSetter_1de0 (index/literal based, no this-field visible), so per-slot targets for those modes cannot be enumerated from this packet.
The relationship between the literal 99999.0 and the read-only global flt_59E928 compared by PerElementConditionalActionDispatcher is not established.

TriPointerReleaser and DualPointerReleaser free pointer fields at equal offsets (+0x04, +0x0C) but on separate `this` objects; whether they are one object family or two is unproven, so equal offsets are not merged across classes per the evidence rules.
The meaning of the bit-1 dirty flag on PitStopParameterStore, the reader of byte_7CE260, and the phase values 3 vs 4 in SeasonDataGate session_phase are not established from this packet.

The legacy ABI label 'HotlapRecordingCheck' (abi:lead) attached to 0x004B17B0 is inconsistent with the raw source, which frees season data at half distance; the SeasonDataGate naming follows the analysis fill at DERIVED trust.
